title: Unadopted A105 scoring sheet: paired calibrated product-assay example
description: A formal result sheet populated by readers, not grading rules. Scoped worked example; no annotation-credit formula or point schedule. Native numeric meanings reuse the existing domain atom schema. The assay reference is an explicitly declared shared experiment identity, never inferred from equal values. Unknown correspondence stays unknown.

investigation_finding.description: Optional typed scientific information in this assessment. source_claim names the actual observed/source-reported subject, proposition and conditions, not a transferred target measurement. The assessment hypothesis is the target issue. qualification states an explicit limitation; valid negative/nontransferable findings remain retained. Withdrawn means this finding is no longer relied upon, with a concrete reason. same_source_claim_as_ref can identify an earlier assessment of the same underlying source claim when names/representations differ; that is an explicit episode interpretation, not automatically proven equivalence. replaces_refs names exact earlier assessment findings corrected by this one. Quotes, IDs, account copies and scoring opinions are not new information.
